comment: Both sizes come from one template, X4.cpp:6-93. The knob at row k and column j sets what input k contributes to output j, X4.cpp:60, and each modulation jack belongs to one of those knobs. The modulation is added to the knob and the total clamped to 0 to 1, X4.cpp:66-67, unlike X8 where it multiplies. A modulation jack is read only while its attenuator is above zero, X4.cpp:63. Connections are checked once every 32 samples, X4.cpp:36. The signal inputs and outputs get no family because they carry whatever is patched in.
